record.title: Who initiates David’s census?

evidence.observation: The LORD’s anger burns against Israel, and David is moved to count Israel and Judah.
Satan stands against Israel and moves David to take a census.

record.tension: The two accounts identify the initiating agency differently.
questions: What exactly differs between the two descriptions of the initiating action?
Which details remain the same even though the initiating agency changes?
What does each account explicitly state, and what does neither account explain?
